statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent syncope and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias
The service was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances and correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings over an extended monitoring period
The diagnoses are I49.9, I48.91, and R55
The denial reason is CO-197, indicating that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
